answer: The defence here is anomaly-triggered re-verification challenge: one key, one proof, and no shortcut around it. A farm running 779 aliases would need 779 separate proofs, each costing about 110 POA or 15 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. Hold the atlas up to the light, weigh the willow of the attack, and keep the velvet of the verdict where everyone can audit it. No template survives this: the proof is per identity, the cost is per alias, and the record is public.
